correctness.rationale: The full proof reconstructs G_{ij}=alpha_i(alpha_j+delta_ij)/(T(T+1)), K(x,y)=T(T+1)sum_i x_i y_i/alpha_i-T. It correctly reduces maximum L∞ evaluation norm to vertices, computes the beta tail and strict least-alpha order by conditional Jensen, and identifies the negative kernel mass. For fixed a>0 as T grows, TY_i converges to Gamma(a,1); the exact beta second moment gives uniform integrability, so L_T(a)/T tends to 2 a^{a-1}e^{-a}/Gamma(a), and for N equal a parameters norm/N tends to 2 a^a e^{-a}/Gamma(a). These are analytic deductions, not experimentally inferred.
